use default

search(text: string, pattern: string) -> LIST[int] is
    let m = pattern.length
    let n = text.length
    let hits = LIST[int]()

    if m == 0 \/ m > n then
        return hits
    fi

    let last_occurrence = MAP[char, int]()

    for i in 0..m do
        last_occurrence[pattern[i]] = i
    od

    let s mut = 0

    while s <= n - m do
        let j mut = m - 1

        while j >= 0 /\ text[s + j] == pattern[j] do
            j = j - 1
        od

        if j < 0 then
            hits.add(s)
            s = s + 1
        else
            let c = text[s + j]
            let last =
                if last_occurrence.contains_key(c) then
                    last_occurrence[c]
                else
                    -1
                fi
            let shift = j - last

            s = s + (if shift > 1 then shift else 1 fi)
        fi
    od

    hits
si

let pattern = "alfalfa"
let text =
    "alfredo behalf calfskin alfalfa halfhearted malfunction severalfold"

let hits = search(text, pattern)

write_line("text:    {text}")
write_line("pattern: {pattern}")
write_line("matches at: {hits |> map(i => "{i}") |> join(", ")}")

for hit in hits do
    write_line("  {hit}: {text[hit..hit + pattern.length]}")
od
